text:
marie: FYI I opened PR 6198 to replace a live KMS example in the SDK migration guide with a redacted example and an explicit rotate-flow snippet. This touches 'sensitive examples' so I need legal + security signoff before merging. CI/docs-preview is failing lint with `no-secrets-in-examples`. Can someone help?

jordan: @marie can you paste the exact snippet you removed/added? legal to confirm redaction + retention language. timeline for merge? looking at next docs-staging slot 14:00-14:30 PT.

marie: removed the plaintext key block and replaced with:

```
# DO NOT COMMIT PLAINTEXT KEYS
kms_key_id: <REDACTED: KMS_KEY_ID>
# Use KMSClient.rotate_key(old, new) in production
```

also added a short paragraph describing retention: "Do not include real key identifiers or credential artifacts in PRs, CI logs, or published screenshots. Example values must be scrubbed before CI artifacts are uploaded." 

sam: security check: please ensure (1) no leftover fingerprints in commit history, (2) the rotate snippet uses the stable client API (no direct HTTP calls with keys), (3) CI artifacts masking is enforced. If you post the linter error I can triage. :shield: 

marie: linter output: `docs-lint: no-secrets-in-examples: found 'AKIA' pattern in previous commit (line 42)`. I rebased and removed the commit but preview still fails because the linter scans the git history in the PR branch. 

alex: we can fix linter config to ignore the removed commit if the repository is told to scan only HEAD, but I'd prefer removing the offending blob via git filter-branch or BFG. Do you want me to rewrite the branch? 

marie: prefer minimal surgery. If security signs off that the blob was replaced and current HEAD contains only redacted values, can we proceed? 

jordan: legal: we need explicit statement about data retention in the PR description and a note that screenshots were removed. Also request a short audit comment: "legal-reviewed: kms-examples (2026-03-21)".

sam: security can conditionally approve after (1) branch rewrite or confirmation that the offending blob is gone, (2) docs-preview artifacts do not contain the redacted token, (3) add `security-reviewed: true` label on the PR. 

deploy-bot: docs-preview #6198 failed: lint error `no-secrets-in-examples`. Artifacts retained for 14 days. Masked variables: REDWOOD_KMS_TOKEN (masked). Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-6198 (expired artifacts will be cleaned). 

alex: I can rewrite branch to drop the blob and force-push, then re-run preview. I'll also add `post-build: rm -rf /tmp/docs_preview/*` to the job and enable artifact masking for the job step that uploads logs. 

marie: please do that and ping here. I'll update PR description with legal text and add the security label once approved. Plan to merge in 14:10 PT slot if preview clears. 

deploy-bot: docs-preview #6198 re-run: success. Link: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-6198 (expires in 14 days). Artifact cleanup step executed. 

tina: product note: thanks for moving this. please add a short note in the migration guide about how rotate affects cache keys and model-serving config. 

marie: added micro-note about cache key invalidation and pushed. Scheduling merge for 14:12 PT to leave a 2-minute buffer. Thanks everyone :tada:
